name: Danger Guard
description: Deterministic pre-exec interception of destructive shell commands. Pattern matching outside the model, approval gates, and Feishu alerts.

level1Patterns.description: Extra regex patterns (case-insensitive) treated as critical: blocked pending owner approval

level2Patterns.description: Extra regex patterns treated as risky: approval required with warning severity

whitelistPatterns.description: Regex patterns that skip interception entirely (e.g. temp dirs)
